description: Settings for the Simple AI chat. The Help Guide works without any AI; these settings control the optional AI Agent.

fields.description: Free - Local AI runs on this server and needs no key. Gemini, Groq and OpenRouter give a free API key after sign-up (with daily limits). OpenAI and Anthropic are paid. Custom works with any OpenAI-compatible API (for example DeepSeek, Mistral, Together, Azure OpenAI or your own server).
fields.label: AI Provider
fields.options:
Free - Local AI (Ollama)
Google Gemini (free API key)
Groq (free API key)
OpenRouter (free models)
OpenAI (ChatGPT)
Anthropic (Claude)
Custom (any OpenAI-compatible API)

fields.description: Not needed for Free - Local AI. Optional for a Custom server that has no key.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Leave empty for the provider's default: qwen3:4b-instruct (Local), gemini-flash-lite-latest (Gemini), llama-3.3-70b-versatile (Groq), openrouter/auto, gpt-4.1-mini, claude-opus-5-5. Required for Custom.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: The API address, ending in /v1 for most providers (for example https://api.deepseek.com/v1). Leave empty to use the provider's standard address. Required for Custom.
fields.label: Server URL

fields.description: One model per line, tried in order when the main model is busy, rate-limited or down. Leave empty to use the built-in list for the provider.
fields.label: Fallback Models

fields.description: When every cloud model fails, use the free local AI on this server (slower).
fields.label: Use Local AI as Last Fallback

fields.description: Seconds to wait for a model before trying the next one.
fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: How much the model thinks before acting. Low is fastest. Ignored by models that do not support it.
fields.label: Reasoning Effort

fields.description: Fast gives the AI a short list of one-call tools (purchase, sales, stock transfer, lookups), which makes it quicker and more reliable. All tools also allow editing drafts and reading any screen's fields.
fields.label: Tool Set

fields.description: How much Claude thinks before acting. Higher is slower but more careful.
fields.label: Claude Effort

fields.description: Extra rules for the AI Agent, for example a default warehouse or naming conventions.
fields.label: Company Instructions

name: AI Assistant Settings
